pretreatments.description: Milling and Grinding: Two rounds of shredding and grinding to reduce the size of particles, followed by screening to achieve a final particle size of 3 ± 0.5 mm. This involved mechanical conveyance to the pretreatment section.

Biological Pretreatment: Joint action of native microbiota (Clostridium, Lactobacillus, and Enterobacter) primarily hydrolyzing xylan into volatile fatty acids (acetic acid). Simulated solely as acetic acid.
Enzymatic Pretreatment: Action of Cellulase 50XL enzyme cocktail (293 EGU/g) in 50 mM citrate buffer pH 6, releasing glucose, galactose, arabinose, and other sugars (69% COD).

Dilute Acid Pretreatment: Solubilization of all xylan and partially cellulose in 1.8% HCl under soft operating conditions, recovering sugars and eliminating inhibitors (furfural, hydroxymethylfurfural, and phenols).

Steam Explosion Pretreatment: Solubilization of xylan producing a mixture of sugars and acetic acid at 116 °C-15 min, generating low concentrations of furfural (0.7 g/L) and hydroxymethylfurfural (0.12 g/L).
No Pretreatment: Direct methanization of Agave bagasse after milling, with the digestate used to produce power.
